part.text:
## Objective
- Rework the MTD quiz prototype so it uses full-screen normal page scroll instead of a modal/iframe clipping pattern.
- Apply the original site’s link, button, and option-card interaction states using shared class-level CSS only.

## Important Details
- Target page: `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- Source/template: `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html`.
- Generated by: `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`.
- Relevant styles: `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`, `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`.
- Quiz currently runs inside an iframe.
- Required viewports to verify: `1280x720`, `1024x540`.
- Specific clipped UI: bottom “Before continuing” banner on question 2 when answering “Yes, but I have not shared it with them yet”.
- Requirement: no inner scroll container.
- Requirement: “Previous” link and all quiz links must have default, hover, focus-visible, and active states.
- Requirement: buttons and option cards must have default, hover, pressed, and focus states from the original site `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Requirement: set each state once on a shared class, never per instance.
- Keep changes minimal, touch only related files, leave no debug code, and do not commit.
- Serve locally with `python3 -m http.server 8150` and open `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- Playwright is available in `node_modules` if browser verification is needed.

## Work State
### Completed
- Confirmed `python3 ~/.agents/bin/start-card.py` is not available: `can't open file '/root/.agents/bin/start-card.py': [Errno 2] No such file or directory`.
- Read `skills/ROUTE.md` to check the repo’s routing/process guidance.

### Active
- Need to inspect the quiz layout, iframe/container styles, and shared interaction-state CSS.
- Need to identify where the quiz is constrained to a modal/inner-scroll pattern and replace it with full-page scroll.
- Need to add or adjust shared CSS classes for links, buttons, and option-card states.

### Blocked
- No hard blocker found yet.
- Exact original-site state values still need to be inferred or copied from the reference site/asset styles if not already present in repo conventions.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`, `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html`, `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`, and `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`.
2. Change the quiz container/iframe/scroll styles so the quiz uses normal page scroll with no inner scroll container, then verify the bottom banner at `1280x720` and `1024x540`.

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`: served quiz page to be modified.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html`: source/template for the variant output.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`: likely regenerates `variant-a/index.html`.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`: main quiz styling.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`: variant styling, likely contains modal/iframe/layout rules.
- `skills/ROUTE.md`: repo routing guidance consulted during startup.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

## Objective
- Rework the MTD quiz prototype to use full-screen normal page scroll instead of a modal/inner-scroll container.
- Apply the original site’s interaction states for quiz links, buttons, and option cards using shared class-level CSS only.

## Important Details
- Target served page: `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- `variant-a/index.html` is marked `GENERATED FILE — do not edit` and is built by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` from `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html`.
- Source/template: `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html`.
- Quiz-related source files:
  - `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`
  - `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`
  - `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-modal.js`
  - `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-frame.js`
  - `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz.js`
  - `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/a11y.js`
  - `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/`
- Required viewport checks: `1280x720` and `1024x540`.
- Specific defect: bottom “Before continuing” banner on question 2 is clipped when answering “Yes, but I haven’t shared with them yet”.
- No inner scroll container is allowed for the quiz.
- Links, including “Previous”, need default, hover, focus-visible, and active states.
- Buttons and option cards need default, hover, pressed, and focus states from `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Each state must be set exactly once on a shared class, never per instance.
- `skills/shared/states.md` says: “Write rest, hover, focus, and active before editing any of them. One state fixed alone leaves the same defect on the next state.”
- Keep changes minimal, touch only related files, leave no debug code, and do not commit.
- Serve with `python3 -m http.server 8150` and test `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- Playwright is available in `node_modules` if browser verification is needed.

## Work State

- Need to decide whether changes should go in `mtd-income-tax/` source and then rebuild/verify `variant-a/index.html`, instead of editing the generated file directly.
- Need to add or adjust shared CSS classes for link, button, and option-card states.

### Blocked

- Exact original-site state values may still need to be inferred from the reference site or existing repo CSS conventions.

## Next Move

Read `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`, `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`, `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-modal.js`, `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-frame.js`, and the quiz container markup in `variant-a/index.html` / `mtd-income-tax/index.html`.

2:    an inner scrollbar. Same-origin static hosting: read the document height and
3:    follow the quiz's own screen-change event. Under file:// the read is blocked
4:    by the browser's opaque origin; the CSS min-height then keeps the frame
5:    usable. */

8:   if (!frame) return;
9:   var timer = 0;

11:   function fit() {
12:     try {
13:       var doc = frame.contentDocument;
14:       if (!doc || !doc.documentElement) return;
15:       var height = Math.max(
16:         doc.documentElement.scrollHeight,
17:         doc.body ? doc.body.scrollHeight : 0,
18:         640
19:       );
20:       if (height > 0) {
21:         var next = Math.ceil(height);
22:         if (Math.abs(frame.getBoundingClientRect().height - next) > 1) {
23:           frame.style.height = next + "px";
24:         }
25:       }
26:     } catch (error) {
27:       /* file:// opaque origin: leave the CSS min-height in place */
28:     }
29:   }
30: 
31:   function soon() {
32:     window.clearTimeout(timer);
33:     timer = window.setTimeout(fit, 50);
34:   }
35: 
36:   function watch() {
37:     fit();
38:     window.setTimeout(fit, 300);
39:     window.setTimeout(fit, 1200);

41:       var win = frame.contentWindow;
42:       var doc = frame.contentDocument;

44:       win.__mtdHeightWatch = true;

48:         subtree: true,
49:         childList: true,

52:       });
53:       if (window.ResizeObserver) {

## Objective
- Convert the MTD quiz from a modal/iframe/inner-scroll experience to normal full-page scroll while keeping the quiz functional.
- Apply the original site’s interaction states for quiz links, buttons, and option cards using shared class-level CSS.

## Important Details
- All paths below are relative to `/content/bakeoff/quizrepo/`.
- Served target page: `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` is generated from `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html` by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`; edit source, not the generated page.
- No inner scroll container is allowed for the quiz; it must scroll with the page.
- Specific defect to fix: bottom “Before continuing” banner on question 2 is clipped when answering “Yes, but I haven’t shared with them yet”.
- Required viewports: `1280x720` and `1024x540`.
- Link states, including “Previous”: rest, hover, focus-visible, active.
- Buttons and option cards need rest, hover, pressed/active, and focus states.
- Reference for interaction states: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- `skills/shared/states.md` requires writing rest, hover, focus, and active states together before editing them.
- Each state must be defined once on a shared class, not per instance.
- Keep edits minimal, touch only related files, leave no debug code, and do not commit.
- Serve with `python3 -m http.server 8150` and test `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- Playwright is available in `node_modules` if browser verification is needed.
- Current Variant A quiz behavior uses a dialog and iframe:
  - `#mtd-quiz-modal`
  - `.mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a`
  - `#mtd-quiz-frame`
  - trigger `[data-mtd-quiz-trigger]` or `.button-checkout`
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` contains:
  - `.mtd-quiz-panel`-related banner styles
  - `.mtd-quiz-section { scroll-margin-top: 80px; }`
  - `.mtd-quiz-frame { min-height: 640px; }`
  - `.mtd-quiz-modal[hidden] { display: none; }`
  - `.mtd-quiz-modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; ... }`
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-modal.js` implements an accessible dialog:
  - opens from hero trigger
  - focus trapping
  - Esc close
  - focus return
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-frame.js` keeps the frame flush with content to avoid an inner scrollbar:
  - targets `#mtd-quiz-frame`
  - reads `contentDocument.scrollHeight` / `body.scrollHeight`
  - enforces min height `640px`
  - listens for `mtd-quiz:event`, MutationObserver, ResizeObserver
  - `file://` fallback leaves CSS min-height in place
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz.js`:
  - used by Variant A/B only
  - advances the embedded quiz past its entry card using `/start your mtd check/i`
  - Variant A only injects `variant-quiz-figma.css` into the iframe
  - Variant A only fits iframe height, rewrites progress fill, swaps Q1 icons, hides helper/support CTA
  - registered `mtd-income-tax` page does not load this file
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`:
  - Variant A modal-only restyle for the embedded quiz iframe
  - targets frozen vendor bundle classes: `Questions-styles__*`
  - also targets stable styled-components suffixes: `fGtfKe`, `kyStRA`, `hnTQsX`, `lScyZ`, `hSoqJU`, `eAvKFB`, `hePGzN`, `jroPAt`, `kwDpZY`, `gomnIV`, `hntNzi`
  - injects fonts and Figma-driven layout/state rules
  - comment says the frame itself scrolls when quiz content is taller than the viewport

## Work State
### Completed
- Confirmed `python3 ~/.agents/bin/start-card.py` is unavailable with: `can't open file '/root/.agents/bin/start-card.py': [Errno 2] No such file or directory`.

- Read `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-modal.js` and identified dialog/open/focus behavior.

- Read `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-frame.js` and identified iframe auto-height / inner-scroll avoidance behavior.

### Active
- Need to inspect the quiz container markup in `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html` and the generated `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- Need to locate the exact modal wrapper, iframe, trigger link, button/link/card classes, and state markup.

14:       if (!doc || !doc.documentElement) return;
15:       var height = Math.max(
16:         doc.documentElement.scrollHeight,
17:         doc.body ? doc.body.scrollHeight : 0,
18:         640
19:       );

22:         if (Math.abs(frame.getBoundingClientRect().height - next) > 1) {
23:           frame.style.height = next + "px";

26:     } catch (error) {

28:     }
29:   }

32:     window.clearTimeout(timer);

> **Source of Truth for Project Delivery, Multi-Agent Fleet, and Design System Governance.**

> Status Legend: `[x]` Done · `[~]` In Progress · `[ ]` Open / Todo

## 0. Universal Governance & Engineering Doctrine

Standing rules governing all changes across every project, component, and agent workflow:

1. **Strict 8-Point Spacing Grid**:
   - All padding, margins, gutters, and layout gaps across product UI and page shells must strictly be multiples of 8 (e.g. 8px, 16px, 24px, 32px) or standard 4px sub-grid steps.
   - **Zero tolerance for odd values**: Unprincipled values like 7px, 10px, or 15px are strictly banned and fail `node tooling/check-spacing.js`.
2. **Product UI Typography**:
   - Every product UI window (`.s50cs-win`, `.s50is-win`, `.tx-win`, `.ncs-win`, `.mrw-win`, `.s50-win`, `.ar-window`, `.hb05-portal`) strictly inherits **Sage UI** (`"Sage UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif`).
   - `Sage Text`, `Sage Headline`, and serifs are strictly forbidden inside product UI surfaces (`node tooling/check-product-ui-type.js`).
3. **Approved Icon Freeze**:
   - Approved icons are locked by SHA-256 hash in `tooling/approved-icons.lock.json` (`node tooling/check-icon-drift.js --check`).
